prompt:
Use the reference image for everything about the world and characters: the same thawed fatty beef roll character (deep red marbled beef with creamy white fat swirls rolled into a cylinder, googly eyes, small toothless mouth, tiny pale fat arms and legs), the same single big round dark iron hotpot (no dividers) full of glossy red chili oil broth at a rolling boil, the same pair of wooden chopsticks resting on the left pot rim, the same chili and Sichuan peppercorn characters, the same wooden table and warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant background. Same camera: about 40 degrees above, wide framing showing about 90% of the pot including the rim and both handles. New moment: the beef roll has just leapt off the end of the chopsticks and is in mid-air above the center of the pot, doing a cannonball dive: curled up, tiny arms hugging its knees, eyes squeezed shut in a brave determined face, about to hit the broth. A little motion trail of steam behind it. Below, all the chili and peppercorn characters look straight up at it with mouths wide open in excitement, some covering their eyes with tiny hands, one chili pointing up. The empty chopsticks still slightly bouncing. Photorealistic textures, glistening oil, warm red and amber tones, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No comic motion lines or symbols, no humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
